versions.description: Initial release of 21-band spectrum analyzer firmware
Improved FFT algorithm for better frequency response
Enhanced Auto Gain with adjustable sensitivity via potentiometer. Improved visualization with balanced frequency response and reduced loudness bias for more precise audio analysis.
Default animation pattern set to colored bars + white peaks (mode 2). In calibration mode DYI1 (pink), the sensitivity of the top frequency bands (17–20 of 21) is doubled.
